extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners and counsel seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO (Office of Enrollment and Discipline)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural standards and expectations for petitions to reinstate an individual to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, including required filings and the review scope used by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitioner must file an Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58 in support of the Petition for Reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision notes that Ms. Yang, through counsel, filed such an affidavit; inclusion of an affidavit under this regulatory provision is treated as a required supporting document for a reinstatement petition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of review for reinstatement eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director reviews the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to the petitioner's eligibility for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The phrase from the decision: 'After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to her eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.' This indicates the Office considers both submitted materials and existing record information when assessing eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision authority and standard of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline (Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline) determines whether reinstatement to practice before the USPTO is appropriate and may grant the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document demonstrates that reinstatement is within the Director's discretion after review; the formal grant is memorialized as a written decision (including signature and date).
